en: Black-and-white winter street scene in a European city. Snow covers the ground and roofs. On the left is a large ornate stone building with arched windows at street level and a gabled central section, likely a public or municipal building facing a small square or open area. On the right, a row of multi‑storey 19th‑century style townhouses with shops at street level lines a slightly descending street. Several pedestrians walk along the sidewalks and a few 1950s–1960s style cars drive along the snow-covered road. No visible caption or printed text is present in the image.
